title: Twenty-five dollars is not the price
learning_goal: Distinguish an installment payment from total purchase commitment and see simultaneous loans stack.
subject: personal finance
must_not_claim: A predicted payment schedule for any actual lender

approved_facts.statement: In this hypothetical example, a $100 pair of headphones is paid in four equal $25 installments, with no interest or fees.
Three $100 purchases made on the same day under identical four-payment schedules require $75 at each payment point, not $25.
The three purchases cost $300 total. Paying $75 initially leaves $225 of scheduled payments; splitting payments changes timing, not the purchase price.
Buy Now Pay Later terms vary; some plans have interest or fees. This illustration assumes no interest or fees.
